title: Marketing Automation Manager
description:
Marketing Automation & HubSpot Specialist

Milton Keynes Hybrid
£45,000 - £50,000

We're working with a growing B2 B business in Milton Keynes looking for a Marketing Automation & HubSpot Specialist to take ownership of HubSpot, automation and lead nurture.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys improving how marketing technology works, building smarter customer journeys and helping turn marketing engagement into genuine sales opportunities.

What you'll be doing
- Taking ownership of HubSpot Marketing Hub
- Building and optimising automated workflows and nurture journeys
- Managing lead scoring, segmentation and lifecycle stages
- Creating targeted email campaigns
- Improving MQL to SQL conversion alongside Sales
- Building dashboards to track campaign performance, pipeline and attribution
- Managing landing pages, forms and lead capture processes
- Maintaining CRM data quality
- Exploring how AI and automation can improve marketing performance

What we're looking for
- Hands-on HubSpot experience
- Experience with marketing automation, email and nurture campaigns
- Understanding of B2 B lead generation and sales funnels
- Confident with reporting, data and campaign analysis
- Experience with lead scoring, segmentation and CRM management
- Comfortable working closely with both Marketing and Sales

Experience within B2 B technology, SaaS or professional services would be beneficial but isn't essential.

This is a great opportunity to take real ownership of HubSpot and help shape how a growing business uses marketing automation to generate and convert more opportunities.

title: PPC Executive
description:
Are you passionate about paid media and looking to take your PPC skills to the next level? Our client is seeking a talented PPC Executive to join their dynamic team on a permanent basis. This role offers the chance to work closely with an experienced PPC lead, managing and optimising client campaigns, analysing performance, and delivering measurable commercial results.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
- Manage and optimise PPC campaigns across a diverse client portfolio, primarily using Google Ads.
- Collaborate with the PPC lead on account strategy, campaign structure, bidding strategies, and budget allocation.
- Build and manage new Search, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types.
- Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis, negative keyword management, and ongoing account optimisation.
- Monitor budgets, cost per lead, conversion rates, ROAS, and other key performance indicators.
- Identify underperforming campaigns and investigate the reasons behind performance changes.
- Produce clear performance reports and turn data into actionable recommendations.
- Participate in client meetings, explaining campaign performance clearly and confidently.
- Work with landing pages and client websites to improve conversion rates.

Skills and Experience:
- Proven experience managing Google Ads campaigns and making optimisation decisions.
- Strong understanding of paid search fundamentals.
- Analytical mindset with a keen interest in investigating performance changes.
- Attention to detail, especially around budgets, tracking, and campaign configuration.
- Comfortable managing multiple client accounts and priorities.
- Clear communication skills with colleagues and clients.
- Commercially minded, focusing on leads, sales, and revenue.
- Right to work in the UK (visa sponsorship not available).

Company Benefits:
- Competitive salary based on experience.
- Birthday off.
- Friendly, energetic team environment.
- Genuine learning and development opportunities in PPC and digital marketing.
- Exposure to a varied portfolio of clients and industries.
- Clear paths for career progression and increased responsibility.
- Social events with the team.

Ready to elevate your PPC career? Apply now to join a growing team that values straightforward communication, practical strategies, and long-term client relationships.
